title: Crash on start-up when using Compatibility renderer (signal 11)
body:
### Tested versions

Bug is reproducible in:
- Godot 4.5-dev3 (official release)
- Godot 4.5-dev3 (compiled from source, commit 19bb18716ef08b811fec330cba4d35fbdb027bcc)
- Godot 4.4.1 (official release)

Couldn't test:
- Godot 4.4 (official release) - Crashed before the project select menu even loaded (signal 11)

Bug is *not* reproducible in:
- Godot 4.3 (official release)
- Godot 4.2 (official release)


### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (19bb18716) - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 (nvidia; 560.35.03) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-3770 CPU @ 3.40GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

**NOTE:** In the system information it specifies Forward+ as the renderer, but this bug actually relates to the Compatibility renderer. I needed to use Forward+ to get the editor to load so I could copy my system info.

When creating a brand new project and selecting the Compatibility renderer, the editor window starts to load but then crashes soon after. In the terminal here is the backtrace:

```
================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.dev3.official (28089c40c13597bf908802c61352c6fffe0a4465) 
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[1] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x45330) [0x7c7d9c245330] (??:0)
-- END OF BACKTRACE --
================================================================        
```

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6ec74003-26f9-4671-97f8-9f6cf20d8cbd)

When selecting the Forward+ or the Mobile renderer, the editor loads as expected.

This issue seems to be reproducible even when starting the project in recovery mode. I have also tried using the `--recovery` flag on Godot itself, but that also doesn't seem to fix the issue.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Load Godot
2. Create a new project with the Compatibility renderer
3. Edit the project - the editor will crash

N/A
